author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 1.2.0 - Closed a silent failure. When the window is open at dusk the app waits for it to close before lowering the blind - but that wait had no end: if the window was left open all night you got one message at dusk and then nothing, with the blind still up and the app quietly holding until morning. It now reminds you while it is still waiting (every 60 minutes by default, up to 3 reminders, both configurable, 0 turns reminders off), and the app's status page shows how many reminders have been sent. The blind is still never lowered onto an open window - dropping a shade onto an open sash or screen is the worse outcome, so the app keeps telling you rather than acting. Note this is a different failure from the one 1.1.0 covers: 1.1.0 catches 'close was commanded but the blind did not move', this catches 'close was never commanded at all'. 1.1.1 - Close verification now also gives a shade reporting 'moving' the same grace it already gave 'closing'/'opening', so a shade still genuinely in motion at the check isn't hit with a premature re-send. No settings change. 1.1.0 - The blind close is now VERIFIED instead of fire-and-forget: a while after commanding close, the app reads the shade back, re-sends close if it hasn't reached 'closed', and alerts you if it never does - so a shade that ignores the command (offline or dead motor) no longer leaves the night 'done' with the blind still up. Tunable under 'Confirm the blind actually closed' (travel time + retries). Also: the before-sunset gate is now OPTIONAL - a new toggle lets the blind lower on the lux threshold alone, at any time of day (e.g. a dark storm). --- Standalone replacement for a Rule Machine room-blinds dawn/dusk rule-set. Once per evening, when an illuminance sensor drops to/below a lux threshold and it is dark (between sunset-offset and sunrise), it lowers the room blind. If the window is open it notifies, waits for the window to close, then lowers the blind; an optional configurable delay can be inserted between the window closing and the blind lowering. If the window is already closed it lowers the blind immediately and turns on the room light only when motion is active. Re-arms each morning at a configurable time. Install one instance per room.
tags: Blinds, Shades, Window Shade, Dusk, Illuminance, Motion, Automation

apps.name: Blinds Dusk Automation
apps.description: Lowers a room's blind at dusk, waiting for an open window to close first, and turns on the room light when occupied.
